# α6700 support matrix

Tested on an ILCE-6700 with firmware 2.00, over Wi-Fi with Access
Authentication on. Details for each item are in [protocol.md](protocol.md).

## Works

| Feature | Notes |
|---|---|
| Connect through SSH (Access Authentication) | keyboard-interactive login; only `localhost` forwards |
| Read all 352 settings with allowed values | 0x9209 |
| Change settings | 0x9205; only values from the setting's own list |
| Follow setting changes | event 0xC203 + 0x9209(1) |
| Capture with AF | fires in every focus mode |
| Capture without AF | fires only in MF; accepted but ignored in AF modes |
| Movie start / stop | |
| Move the AF area | needs a spot or zone focus area |
| Touch tracking + cancel | |
| Camera buttons | one at a time, only while the camera is idle |
| Dials | front, rear, control wheel |
| Live view | 1024×680 JPEG, ~30 fps, no setup needed |
| Live-view level, focus and face frames | tracking frames not seen yet |
| OSD overlay image | 640×480 PNG; mode resets on reconnect |
| New shots to the host | 1616×1080 by default, original size with 0xD268 = 1 |
| List card contents | camera UI stays usable |
| Download files | 10–14 MB/s over Wi-Fi + SSH |
| Thumbnails / screennails | JPEG or HEIF depending on the file |
| Delete contents | |
| Settings backup and restore | about 160 KB |
| Clock and time zone get / set | |
| LUT import into User1–16 | mode dial on **movie** only |
| Display strings (setting names, LUT names) | |
| MTP object property list | needs the contents transfer mode, which locks the UI |

## Advertised but rejected

Lens information, FTP setting list, zoom/focus presets, setting file
(0x9222), restriction query (0x9239), movie playback (0x9243), monitoring
stream, custom grid lines. See [protocol.md](protocol.md#rejected-by-the-a6700).

## Not tested

- Plain PTP/IP without Access Authentication (pairing prompt).
- Power zoom lenses, power on/off over the network, Wake-on-LAN.
- Files of 4 GiB or more (sizes and offsets are 64-bit).
- A second card slot (the α6700 has one).

## Quirks

- The contents transfer mode (0x9212) locks the camera UI. Only MTP object properties and the standard PTP object operations need it.
- No event announces a new shot for the host; poll 0xD215.
- In Movie Auto, a dial turn after using the menu through 0xD309 switched the exposure mode to Movie M.
- The 0x923B capture dates and 0x923C "local" times are camera wall-clock time encoded as UTC.
